# SciConnect

> SciConnect is a bilingual (Serbian and English) platform for discovering scientific institutions and their research capabilities.

## What you can do

Visitors can browse research institutions, scientific instruments, available analyses, researchers, and target microorganisms. SciConnect supports combined capability searches and a map-based view of nearby institutions.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://sciconnect.rs/): Introduction to SciConnect and access to research capability search.
- [Partners](https://sciconnect.rs/partners): Organizations supporting the SciConnect project.
- [Contact](https://sciconnect.rs/kontakt): Contact details for the SciConnect team.
